$comment: Every event hooks/hooks.json registers and the outcomes its handler returns. additionalContext counts as systemMessage. Each event x outcome is proved by one *.scenario.json; `ledger gate check` fails naming the gap.
manual: The real remindctl is never run by a scenario: each one stubs it through REMINDERS_REVIEW_REMINDCTL. Against the real Reminders database, run `REMINDERS_REVIEW_WATCH=<list> node hooks/session-start.mjs <<< '{"session_id":"manual"}'` on a Mac with remindctl authorized and a reminder due today in <list>; it prints the Due block as additionalContext.
